scope: Additive TH18 regular Balloon L1-L13 direct-parent, normal splash and death-damage baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3; the corroborating current secondary page does not identify a build.

sources.title: Balloon — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Confirms L1-L13 parent HP/DPS, 5 housing, 3-second cadence, 0.5 range, movement 10, flight and Defense priority. It describes splash and a dropped death bomb qualitatively but does not publish fixed-tick flight, impact or death-delay ordering.

sources.title: Balloon CoC 2026: Level 13 Stats, Upgrades & Attack Guide
sources.version: current page, client build not published
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L13 bomb and death damage, 1.2-tile splash radius, ground-only nearby death effect, speed 10 and 0.5 range. It supplies no replay, projectile trajectory, collision or fixed-tick timing contract.

splash_radius_tiles.note: Current secondary documentation quantifies the normal bomb splash; Core already applies catalogue splash through its shared projectile impact path.

support.note: The L1-L13 flying defense-priority parent, its documented normal splash and existing ground-only death bomb run through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL paths.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent with an unquantified normal splash radius; death damage remained historical Core data without a current source contract.
changed_values.replacement: Shared Core activates a 1.2-tile normal bomb splash and classifies the L1-L13 parent as executable; existing 1.2-tile ground-only death damage is corroborated.
changed_values.justification: The current secondary page supplies the radius and level table; no flight or timing rule is introduced.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines bomb/drop projectile speed, launch origin, impact delay, collision, target loss, attack wind-up, target ties or same-tick ordering.
No consulted source defines death-bomb delay, exact landing coordinate, overlap handling, interaction order with other deaths/traps/spells, or visual asset fidelity.
The current exact values and radius are secondary; no primary public quantitative Balloon contract was found.
conclusion: Balloon L1-L13 is executable through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a flying Defense-priority parent with 1.2-tile normal splash and the corroborated ground-only death bomb. Flight, timing, collision and visual fidelity remain partial.
